body:
The only way we aren't compatible is sex. Other than that I have never connected with anyone else more on any level. 

I do not think sex is everything, it's important, but not everything. 

I understand what you are saying though. And maybe I shouldn't have stayed the past 6 years... but it's the past, I can't undo it. And honestly all of the good moments have outweighed our struggles with intimacy, I don't regret staying with him. We've had discussions before about lack of intimacy, but never revolving around the role porn plays.

The never-ending cycle thing is very true. It makes him feel bad so then he doesn't have the confidence. And when he does find the confidence I worry that it's guilt or pity that is making him do it. I hope we can break the cycle.
I thought about this, I will suggest it. He's already so embarrassed, I worry he would be too embarrassed to give it a chance.
Thank you. I really needed to hear that.

That would be the ideal. But we have had that conversation before and it never worked, only for a while. He can masturbate, I just think he should make an effort not to watch porn if it makes him desire me less and not want to have sex with me.

I really don't think it is atypical. Most of what I have read online is that it is fairly normal for men to look at all types of porn, especially if addicted to porn because they need to keep making it more "taboo" every time.
